system.description:
• Effect: A new Channel option, costing 2 uses: call on your deity for one of these effects.
  • (1) Reroll any one die result (attack/damage/save/turn undead/attribute check)
  • (2) Advantage on all your attack rolls and double weapon damage dice for 1 round (flat modifiers are not doubled)
  • (3) Halve all damage suffered this round
